title: Column buckling
line: A buckling FEA study of a steel column under a 250 kN axial load.
description: Linear buckling of a steel column (1000 mm tall, 100 x 50 mm section), fixed at its base, with a 250 kN axial load on its top face. A preload step finds the stress state and its geometric stiffness; the buckling step returns the load factor on 250 kN at which the column buckles and the buckled shape.
thumbnailAlt: First buckling mode of a steel column under axial load, solved in RunMat
